hero.title: StillGood
hero.line: My own app that helps families waste less food. It scans your groceries, tracks every expiry date and suggests what to cook before anything goes off.

demo.alt: StillGood scanning a banana, filling in its category and storage spot, and saving it to the pantry

items.title: Scan the Shop
items.text: Point the camera at a product, a barcode, a receipt or the whole haul at once, and Google Gemini fills in the details.
points: One item, a whole benchful or a receipt
Name, category and storage spot filled in
Nothing is saved until you have checked it

items.title: Watch the Dates
items.text: Everything in the pantry counts down, so the food that needs using first is always at the top.
points: Days left on every item
Fridge, freezer, counter and cellar filters
Expiring, expired and consumed totals

items.title: Cook What's Closest
items.text: Recipes are ranked by how many of your expiring items they use, and anything you're missing goes on the shopping list.
points: Meals that rescue the most food come first
What you have and what's missing, before you start
Recipe Studio builds a recipe from ingredients you pick

items.title: Get Told in Time
items.text: Expiry alerts and recipe nudges arrive at the times you choose, with a monthly summary of what stayed out of the bin.
points: Alerts on your own schedule
Recipe nudges for food close to expiry
Every alert kept in an inbox in the app

tiers.title: One App, Three Tiers
tiers.line: Every tier is the same app. Upgrading raises the limits and, on Family, adds a shared household.

items.name: Basic
points: The whole loop: scan, track, cook and restock
Up to 45 pantry items
2 expiry and 2 recipe alerts

items.name: Pro
points: More AI scans and an unlimited pantry
Expiry dates read by the camera, or estimated
Recipe Studio and personal analytics

items.name: Family
points: A shared pantry beside everyone's own
Up to 8 members, with who added what
Household analytics and shared lists

builtWith.title: Built by Me, with an AI Pair Programmer
builtWith.text: I designed and developed the mobile app, the backend server and the website all by myself. I used Claude Code, an AI coding assistant, to work faster: I decided how everything should work and reviewed every piece of code it wrote before using it.
